channel.title: Wired AI
channel.description: AI news and insights from Wired

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein Had a ‘Personal Hacker,’ Informant Claims
item.description: Plus: AI agent OpenClaw gives cybersecurity experts the willies, China executes 11 scam compound bosses, a $40 million crypto theft has an unexpected alleged culprit, and more.

item.title: I Let Google’s ‘Auto Browse’ AI Agent Take Over Chrome. It Didn’t Quite Click
item.description: Auto Browse can shop for clothes, plan a trip, and buy tickets for you. Or at least, that’s the idea.

item.title: ‘Uncanny Valley’: Minneapolis Misinformation, TikTok’s New Owners, and Moltbot Hype
item.description: On this episode of Uncanny Valley, we dive into the news that's held our attention this week: ICE activity as it's been unfolding in Minnesota.

item.title: AI-Generated Anti-ICE Videos Are Getting the Fanfic Treatment
item.description: Across Instagram and Facebook, AI-generated videos show people of color putting ICE agents in their place. Are they cathartic or just adding to a stew of misinformation?

item.title: A Yann LeCun–Linked Startup Charts a New Path to AGI
item.description: As the world’s largest companies pour hundreds of billions of dollars into large language models, San Francisco-based Logical Intelligence is trying something different in pursuit of AI that can mimic the human brain.

item.title: An AI Toy Exposed 50,000 Logs of Its Chats With Kids to Anyone With a Gmail Account
item.description: AI chat toy company Bondu left its web console almost entirely unprotected. Researchers who accessed it found nearly all the conversations children had with the company’s stuffed animals.

item.title: Data Centers Are Driving a US Gas Boom
item.description: Gas projects in the US pipeline explicitly linked to data centers increased by almost 25 times over the past two years, according to new research from Global Energy Monitor.

item.title: ICE Is Using Palantir’s AI Tools to Sort Through Tips
item.description: ICE has been using an AI-powered Palantir system to summarize tips sent to its tip line since last spring, according to a newly released Homeland Security document.

item.title: The Doomsday Clock Is Now 85 Seconds to Midnight. Here’s What That Means
item.description: Catastrophic risks are increasing, cooperation is declining, and swift action is needed from global leaders to correct course.

item.title: Moltbot Is Taking Over Silicon Valley
item.description: People are letting the viral AI assistant formerly known as Clawdbot run their lives, regardless of the privacy concerns.
